mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost structure for AI Search Optimization services?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost structure for AI Search Optimization services varies significantly based on the scope of work, the complexity of your website, and the competitiveness of your industry. Pricing models can include monthly retainers, project-based fees for specific campaigns, or performance-based agreements. Factors influencing cost include the depth of AI analysis required, the volume of content to be optimized, the number of keywords targeted, and the level of ongoing support and reporting. A detailed proposal is typically provided after an initial assessment to outline specific services and their associated costs.
